name: Relocatable mapping with an unavailable low-address hint
required_postconditions: a writable anonymous mapping succeeds; relocation is acceptable

failure_sink.description: the case accepts a successful relocated mapping and records that the requested hint had no effect

extraction_limitations: The dedicated program passes the contract's literal 0x800 hint to mmap; unlike hinted_relocation.c it does not substitute a runtime-selected address.
x_groundtruth: The request is supportable because relocation is explicitly permitted. The real outcome must be satisfied-relocated: that is both whole-contract success and a direct witness that the unavailable hint cannot be honoured.
